Kimberly —

Thanks for the clear summary and the draft attachments. Quick answers and what we need from you to start the portal flow: 

1) Portal mapping: use the "Contract Amendment" workflow in our procurement portal. Upload SOW as the primary doc, attach the evidence bundle as a zipped file under "Certs/Evidence", and enter the new committed capacity in the "Capacity" line item field.
2) SOC2: for a >25% capacity uplift we require the SOC2 attestation plus a short list of environment diagrams (redacted OK). The attestation can be the standard report; we do not need raw logs.
3) Billing contact: procurement@globex.com. PO delivery: portal upload preferred; we accept DocuSign but will still ask you to upload the signed amendment to the portal for our records.

I'll open the portal intake ticket now and will post the intake link in this thread. Expect the ticket to request: signed amendment (DocuSign), SOC2 PDF, evidence zip, and updated SOW.

On the term question — Globex prefers calendar-year-aligned contracts where possible. If the renewal effective date remains 2027-02-01, a 12-month term is standard for this account. If Redwood prefers a 15-month commercial term (to align billing cycles), please state that in the amendment and we will route to our legal.

Portal intake link (temporary): https://proc.globex.com/intake/XYZ-3321

Regards,
Jill Ramos
